_meta.purpose: Reference constants for the UCO-to-biodiesel app (grading, yield, pricing, demand, emissions). Every value has a confidence flag. 'assumption' = my modelling choice, expose as an editable input in the UI and label it as an estimate.
confidence_scale: low = trade listing, blog, hobbyist guide

edibility_limit_tpc_percent.note: FSSAI maximum Total Polar Compounds for cooking oil. Above this the oil must not be used for cooking. This is the 'retire the oil' trigger.

visual_cues_oil_past_limit.note: Cues listed in FSSAI RUCO news note. Screening cues only, not a measurement.

yellow_grease.note: Used fryer oil, typically under 15% FFA

brown_grease.note: Trap/sewer grease. Needs heavy pretreatment, generally not accepted as feedstock.

single_study_yield_datapoint.value: 10.5% FFA untreated -> 40% yield; pretreated to 2% FFA -> 76% yield
single_study_yield_datapoint.note: One study, use only to justify a grade-based yield penalty.

biodiesel_product_standard.note: Standard named in OMC procurement tenders.

app_grades_proposed.note: Visual screening grades for the app. No validated colour-to-FFA mapping exists in the literature I found, so your own labelled photos define the mapping. Always state: processor confirms with a lab test.

A.label: Prime feedstock
A.cues: light to mid amber, clear, little sediment

B.label: Standard feedstock
B.cues: dark brown, some sediment or foam, needs pretreatment

C.label: Low-grade feedstock
C.cues: near black, viscous, heavy sludge, burnt smell

Reject.label: Not accepted
Reject.cues: visible water layer, trap grease or mixed non-oil waste

app_grades_proposed.retire_alert: If cues match 'visual_cues_oil_past_limit', show 'likely past the 25% TPC limit, stop frying with this oil'.

lab_conversion_oil_to_fame_percent.note: Controlled lab transesterification of clean oil.

volume_per_tonne_uco_litres.source: USDA FAS GAIN India Biofuels Annual (1 MT UCO = 1,043 litres)

collected_oil_contamination_percent.note: A hobbyist guide claims roughly 20% of restaurant-collected oil is water and food bits (low reliability). Default 10, let users move 0-20.

byproduct.note: Show only as a qualitative co-product unless you source a figure.

range_by_quality.source: Pahle India UCO biodiesel research paper

official_2019_reference.note: Price fixed from August 2019 for UCO biodiesel under the earlier scheme; use as history only.

omc_biodiesel_b100_price_per_litre.note: Sources conflict. Tender document: base Rs 80/L for Apr-Jul 2025 (excl. GST and transport) and that tender covers non-UCO feedstocks. Trade press reports Rs 91.20 (Oct 2024-Jan 2025) and Rs 100.12 (Feb-Sep 2025). UCO biodiesel is procured under a separate EOI. Keep as an editable input and state the date.

trade_listing_premium_uco.note: Single ExportersIndia listing. Do not use as a headline number.

blending_target_percent_by_2030.note: National Policy on Biofuels, on-road diesel

volume_needed_for_5pct_litres_per_year.source: USDA FAS GAIN India Biofuels Annual 2025 (about 4.5 billion litres)

diesel_consumption_litres_per_month.source: USDA FAS GAIN 2025 (7.5 billion litres per month)

current_blend_percent.note: OMC blend about 0.49% in the 2025 report; national average projected 0.63% for 2026; USDA expects it to stay below 1% in 2026.

omc_biodiesel_procurement.note: Figures come from trade press and differ by source; show as 'hundreds of millions of litres' rather than one precise number.

uco_potential_litres.note: FSSAI-stated potential of about 220 crore litres recoverable by 2022 (2019 estimate, secondary reporting). Another source estimates 148 crore litres available. Present as 'estimated potential'.

ruco_programme.value: 64 companies at 101 locations identified for collection at launch

demand_india.supply_gap_message: Blending is about 0.5-0.6% against a 5% target, so feedstock collection, not demand, is the bottleneck.

lifecycle_ghg_reduction_uco_biodiesel_vs.note: JEC reports more than 70% well-to-wheel; Argonne GREET-based figures cite 79-86% for UCO biodiesel (secondary source). Default 80%, show range.

carbon_intensity_g_co2e_per_mj.note: US-based values from a trade blog citing GREET. Not India-specific. Say so in the UI.

co2e_avoided_kg_per_litre_biodiesel.note: Uses US carbon intensities. Show as an estimate with the formula visible.

labelling_guidance_for_your_dataset.problem: No public colour-to-FFA or colour-to-TPC mapping I found is validated for phone photos.
recommended_labels: TPC reading if you can borrow a meter or strips (best)
your own A/B/C/Reject call from the cues above
labelling_guidance_for_your_dataset.always_include: reference colour card and clear cup in every photo; same lighting angle; log oil type
